subject: Retroactive geozone purge — evidence scope & timeline
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@greenfieldbank.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cc: ComplianceOps <compliance-ops@consults.io>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Retroactive geozone purge — evidence request

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 readiness work we need documented evidence for a retroactive purge we asked Redwood to run earlier this quarter for a subset of EU tenants. Specifically we need:

- Scope mapping: list of tenant IDs and geo tags that were included in the purge (tenant -> region mapping).
- Proof of deletion: for each tenant, a snapshot of deletion operations (job id, timestamp, object counts, and any error flags).
- Chain-of-custody: how deletion artifacts were produced, stored, and transferred to us (hashes, export filenames).
- Exception log: any tenants that were excluded/failed and reason.

Attached is a simple template (purge_request_template.xlsx) with the fields our auditor expects. Can you confirm whether Redwood can deliver these artifacts, and give an estimated delivery window? Our target is to have everything uploaded to our evidence repo by 2026-06-07 for internal review.

Also copying ComplianceOps — if you prefer I can accept a sampling approach rather than full tenant artifacts; we just need defensible sampling methodology documented.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Head of Vendor Risk
Greenfield Bank

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@greenfieldbank.com>
Cc: ComplianceOps <compliance-ops@consults.io>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Retroactive geozone purge — evidence request

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear template. We can provide the artifacts you listed; a couple clarifying items before we lock timelines:

1) Scope: do you want the full tenant ID set for the EU geozone purge (approx ~1,200 tenants), or would a statistically defensible 10% sample be acceptable? If full, expect longer lead time because of export size and verification.
2) Time range: which purge job(s) are in-scope — the one run on 2026-03-08 (job id RP-20260308) and the follow-up on 2026-04-15 (RP-20260415)?
3) Delivery format: redactable CSVs + sha256 hashlist and a signed attestation works for auditors on most engagements; confirm whether you require a notarized attestation or an in-band signed PDF.

Proposed plan (high level):
- Today: internal kickoff and artifact checklist (I attached a one-pager).
- Tue 2026-06-02: technical export (hashlist + sample traces).
- Wed 2026-06-03 to Thu 2026-06-04: internal validation and signature by Security.
- Fri 2026-06-05: upload to your evidence repo / shared Drive.

If you need full exports for all tenants, push-to-date would be Tue 2026-06-09 depending on export queue and storage.

Vivek and Irene — can you confirm we have the deletion job traces accessible for the requested jobs and whether we can produce a sha256 snapshot for each export?

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Manager, Customer Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial_action_plan.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 10:11:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Retroactive geozone purge — evidence request

Chloe / Priya — quick technical note from infra:

We have job-level traces for RP-20260308 and RP-20260415 stored in our deletion-audit S3 bucket (eu-1 region). For each job we can produce:
- deletion_job_manifest.json (job id, started_at, finished_at, total_items_scanned, total_items_deleted, failures).
- per-tenant deletion-summary.csv (tenant_id, objects_deleted, objects_failed, purge_passed_flag).
- per-tenant hashlist file: tenant-<id>-hashes.sha256 (file contains newline-separated sha256 object hashes for exported deletion artifacts).

Size / performance notes: full export for ~1,200 tenants will be ~45GB compressed. We can generate a zipped bundle of per-tenant manifests and then produce a top-level hashlist_snapshot.zip (contains all tenant-*.sha256 files) — referencing that as the chain-of-custody artifact is fine for auditors.

Sampling approach: if a sample is acceptable, I recommend stratified sampling across tenant size bins (small/medium/large) to ensure deletion behavior across tail cases; 10% stratified sample gives good confidence and trims exports to ~4.5GB compressed.

We will also include a signed checksum manifest and a short runbook that documents the export process (commands, S3 paths, principal who executed the job).

Irene — security will need to sign off on the runbook and the checksum manifest.

-Vivek
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@greenfieldbank.com>, chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 13:42:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Retroactive geozone purge — evidence request

Priya / Chloe — forwarding our internal security checklist and attestation plan.

On our side we will produce the following SOC 2 / ISO-friendly artifacts:
- Export bundle (zipped per-tenant manifests) with signed top-level checksum (sha256).
- Evidence manifest (CSV) mapping tenant_id -> purge_job_id -> exported_filename -> sha256 -> exported_at.
- Operation runbook (PDF) describing the deletion workflow, the automation steps, and operator principals.
- Exception register (CSV) enumerating tenants that failed or were skipped, with remediation notes.
- Chain-of-custody packet: PGP-signed summary + timestamped S3 presigned urls valid 14 days.

We will upload artifacts to a read-only evidence folder in our secure drive and provide signed checksum files and a short attestation letter (signed as a Redwood Security representative). Please confirm if Greenfield requires: (a) notarization; (b) escrow-style handoff (we can provide an SFTP transfer to a Greenfield-managed bucket).

Drive link (internal): https://drive.redwood.internal/docs/geozone-retro-purge-guidance
Jira: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/SUP-4482 (internal traceability ticket)

Proposed schedule:
- Wed 2026-06-02: produce sample bundle + hashes.
- Thu 2026-06-03: Security signature + attestation creation.
- Fri 2026-06-04: Upload and share read-only link with Greenfield.

If Greenfield confirms they need full exports we will re-run and ETA Fri 2026-06-09.

Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
